hypothesis.rationale: Hyperparameters have been exhausted (learning_rate, n_mem_tokens, batch_size, max_steps sweeps all tried). Deep supervision adds auxiliary losses on layers [1,2,3] which may interfere with learning the exact-match task. The best EM (0.0228) was achieved with n_layer=6 but deep supervision was also enabled then; disabling it may help convergence.
hypothesis.instruction: Set use_deep_supervision to false in experiment_config.yaml
